record.context_brief: Rank-2 Clifford bundles with many sections
record.original_question: For a general smooth curve C, does there exist a vector bundle E computing Cliff_2(C) such that h^0(E) > 4?

evidence.quote: Question 3.10. Does there exist a bundle E computing Cliff2(C) on a general curve with h0(E) > 4?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $C$ be a general smooth projective curve of genus $g$ over the complex numbers. For a semistable vector bundle $E$ of rank $r$ and degree $d$ on $C$ with $h^0(E) \ge r+1$ (and, dually, $h^0(K_C \otimes E^\vee) \ge r+1$ where $K_C$ is the canonical bundle), define the Clifford index of $E$ by
$$\mathrm{Cliff}(E) \;=\; \frac{1}{r}\bigl(d - 2(h^0(E) - r)\bigr) \;=\; \mu(E) - \frac{2}{r}\bigl(h^0(E) - r\bigr),$$
where $\mu(E)=d/r$. The rank-$r$ Clifford index of $C$ is
$$\mathrm{Cliff}_r(C) \;=\; \inf\bigl\{\mathrm{Cliff}(E) : E \text{ semistable of rank } r,\ h^0(E) \ge r+1,\ h^0(K_C \otimes E^\vee) \ge r+1\bigr\}.$$
A bundle $E$ is said to compute $\mathrm{Cliff}_r(C)$ if it attains this infimum.

Question: For a general smooth curve $C$, does there exist a rank-$2$ vector bundle $E$ on $C$ that computes $\mathrm{Cliff}_2(C)$ and satisfies $h^0(E) > 4$?
artifact.status_search_result: Recent work (2025) on linear stability and rank-two Clifford indices, and earlier work of Lange–Newstead on bundles computing Cliff_2, characterize bundles computing the rank-2 Clifford index, with known examples on general curves typically having h^0(E)=3 or 4. No source found that resolves the existence of such a bundle with h^0(E)>4 on a general curve, so the problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Linear stability and rank two Clifford indices of algebraic curves
status_evidence.snippet: Any vector bundle computing the rank-two Clifford index of a smooth projective algebraic curve is linearly semistable.
status_evidence.claim: Recent (2025) study of bundles computing Cliff_2; does not establish existence with h^0(E)>4 on general curves.

status_evidence.title: Vector Bundles of Rank 2 Computing Clifford Indices (Lange–Newstead)
status_evidence.snippet: Clifford indices for vector bundles on curves; bundles E computing Cliff_2 with h^0(E)=3 on curves of higher Clifford dimension.
status_evidence.claim: Standard references on Cliff_2 do not give bundles with h^0(E)>4 on a general curve.
